title.value: The KITMUS Test: Evaluating Knowledge Integration from Multiple Sources
title.justification: The paper introduces the KITMUS test suite, which evaluates the integration of knowledge from multiple sources in coreference resolution tasks.
title.quote: We propose KITMUS , 1 a diagnostic test suite. The KITMUS tests evaluate K nowledge I n T egration from MU ltiple S ources.

analysis.description: This paper presents the KITMUS test suite designed to evaluate the ability of Natural Language Understanding (NLU) models to integrate and reason over knowledge available from multiple sources. It focuses particularly on coreference resolution tasks using both entity-specific and background knowledge. By varying the distribution of knowledge types across pretrain-time and inference-time, the study examines how existing state-of-the-art models perform in integrating these knowledge sources, especially using fictional knowledge that models would not have pretrained knowledge about.

type.justification: The paper presents experimental results evaluating the performance of existing NLU models on the KITMUS test suite.
type.quote: We evaluate state-of-the-art coreference resolution models on our dataset.
